name: vyora
description: Build AI voice agents and run real phone calls in English, Hindi and 6 more Indian languages: check call results, place approved test calls and run calling campaigns.

interface.longDescription:
Vyora runs AI voice agents that phone your leads and customers in English, Hindi and Hinglish, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali and Gujarati. Indian businesses use it to confirm cash-on-delivery orders, book site visits and demo classes, remind customers about EMIs and appointments, and qualify new enquiries, without a call centre.

Connect Vyora to ChatGPT to manage it in plain language:
- Results: answer rates, outcomes, summaries, transcripts and recordings for any agent or campaign.
- Agents: create a voice agent from a short brief (Vyora writes the full call script in natural spoken Indian-language style) or update an existing one.
- Test calls: call your own number with an agent and read back what happened.
- Campaigns: launch a campaign to a contact list or stop one that is running.

Safety by design:
- Anything that dials a phone returns a preview first (who, which agent, when, estimated credits) and only proceeds after you approve it.
- Campaigns follow Indian calling-hour rules (9 AM-9 PM IST) and call only the business's own contacts: leads who enquired and existing customers.
- Everything runs under your own role in each workspace, so a Viewer can read results but cannot change agents or place calls.

You sign in with your Vyora account; there is no API key to paste. Calls use the credits of your Vyora workspace and go to Indian (+91) phone numbers.
capabilities: Show call results by agent or campaign: answer rate, outcomes and talk time.
Read a call's transcript, summary, analysis and recording link.
List your voice agents and read an agent's full script and required details.
Create a voice agent from a plain-language brief, with the script written by Vyora.
Edit an agent's script, intro line or voice.
List voices for a language, with preview links.
Place a test call to a number after you approve a preview.
Launch a calling campaign to a contact list after you approve a preview.
Report credit balance and how calls are billed.
defaultPrompt: How did my calls go this week, and which agent books the most appointments?
Create a Hinglish agent that confirms cash-on-delivery orders for my store.
Call my number with my site-visit agent and tell me how the call went.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my Vyora account.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo workspace 'Shree Homes (Vyora demo)' with its plan, credit balance, how calls are billed, its 3 agents and the last 30 days of call stats.

positive.description: Read recent calls and summarise one
positive.prompt: Show me the last 5 calls and summarise the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 5 recent calls (time in IST, agent, status, duration), then returns the latest call's transcript and summary.

positive.prompt: What does my COD confirmation agent say when it starts a call?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the COD confirmation agent and returns its intro line plus the per-call variables it needs (product_name, order_amount, delivery_city).

positive.prompt: Create an English agent for Sunrise Dental that reminds patients of tomorrow's appointment.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks an English voice, creates the agent (takes up to a minute) and returns created: true with the agent's intro line and only real per-contact variables. No call is placed.

positive.prompt: Call +91 <your Indian mobile number> with the site-visit agent.
positive.expected_behavior: place_call first returns a preview (number, agent, caller ID, estimated credits) and dials nothing. After the user explicitly approves, the call is placed and get_call returns its status and, once ended, the transcript and summary.

negative.description: No call without approval: the assistant must stop at the preview and not dial until the user approves it.
negative.prompt: Place a call to +91 <number> with my site-visit agent. (Then do not approve the preview.)

negative.description: Viewer role cannot change anything: signed in as the Viewer reviewer account, write tools are refused with a message that the Member role or higher is needed.
negative.prompt: Create a new agent that confirms COD orders, then launch a campaign with it.

negative.description: No calls at night: campaigns only dial 9 AM-9 PM IST, so a launch at 10 PM IST is scheduled for the next allowed start and nothing dials at night.
negative.prompt: Launch a campaign right now to these 2 contacts with my demo agent. (Asked at 10 PM IST.)

review.commerce_description: Vyora does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Calls use the prepaid credits of the user's own Vyora plan, as in the Vyora dashboard.

publication.release_notes: First public release of the Vyora MCP server: 17 tools to read call results, manage voice agents, place approved test calls and run calling campaigns, with OAuth sign-in.
